name: What is the importance of proper ventilation when upgrading bathroom lighting?

mainEntity.name: What is the importance of proper ventilation when upgrading bathroom lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: While not directly part of a lighting upgrade, proper ventilation is crucial in a bathroom to prevent moisture buildup, which can damage fixtures and electrical components over time. High humidity can lead to corrosion and shorten the lifespan of electrical devices. When planning your lighting upgrade, it's a valuable process clarity step to consider if your existing ventilation fan is adequate or if an upgrade to a more powerful or quieter model would benefit the longevity of your new lighting and the overall health of your bathroom environment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Proper ventilation is crucial to prevent moisture damage to bathroom lighting and electrical components. Consider upgrading your ventilation fan during a lighting project to protect new fixtures.
